content: Commands never touch process.*: they get an Io (cwd, env, stdout, stderr, stdinIsTTY, stdoutIsTTY) via CommandContext. runCli(argv, io) in src/cli.ts returns the exit code. Tests call test-helpers run()/runJson() in-process; only cli-smoke.test.ts spawns the binary. For human commands, pass tty:true in-process. Subprocesses need ROOTS_FORCE_TTY=1 AND NODE_ENV=test (bun test sets NODE_ENV=test).

description: seeds' yaml.ts fails the roots biome cognitive-complexity<=15 rule (emitMap 22, emitSeq 29)
resolution: roots has its own smaller src/yaml.ts: block maps, scalar sequences, flow sequences, comments. It throws on anything else. Do not copy the seeds parser.

description: String flags swallowed the next token even when it was a known flag (roots drift --diff --json took --json as the rev).
resolution: args.ts takeFlag rejects a following known --flag/-x with a usage error suggesting --flag=value for literals.

content: scripts/check-all.ts and check-ci-parity.ts are byte-identical copies of os-eco/templates/l5-toolkit (biome formatter off for them); budgets live in scripts/*.json (seeds layout); CI runs each manifest gate as its own step because ci-parity rev 2 requires every gate be invoked by CI (a lone 'bun run check:all' step does not count).
